original_card.first_experiment: First check whether the scatter repair has been adopted. If still open, independently reproduce #2977 symbolic-versus-exported parity on the tiny duplicate fixture, compare the selected unique-row positive control, and define either enforced uniqueness or consistent multiplicity semantics. A bounded guard-adoption patch must preserve valid inputs and test the actual exported action. Stop after this obligation; no full historical replay or frontier change follows from the mutant alone.

actual_scope: Audit the sign premise in the historical certify_network exponential lower bound and its actual make_patch proof consumer.
scope_change_reason: The selected scatter and census seeds already have live follow-ups #3346 and #3333. A separate exact counterexample exposes a false logarithm implication emitted by the historical proof producer.
bottleneck_link: Side result: close a concrete numerical-certificate/proof-producer domain gap; no selected supplier admission or kappa improvement is claimed.
stop_rule: One negative helper/proof-producer fixture, a proposed in-memory positivity guard, three unchanged published positive cases, bounded rejection controls and a source-aware adoption handoff.
evidence: verify.py, RESULT.json, proposed-guard.patch, four cold Git-free CLI test groups and the elementary exponential-domain argument in README.md.

open_questions.question: How should the positive-log guard be adopted without rewriting frozen historical source pins?
